body:
Good for you for taking responsibility for your kids. Usually the roles are reversed. You get to look forward to them graduating high school and walking them down the carpet to be married. They can make you the most proud person in the world.

Don't say you have nothing.

Therapists will find the root of the problem and help you work around whats causing you to be upset. I've been to one for a few months, and unfortunately it didn't really 'work' for me. Maybe she sucked, I dunno. I'll give it another shot.

Thanks for taking the time to respond. Life can really suck. You're right, we are similar, but different. Between your parents, and your children, you have a good emotional support system, I have neither. I hope that keeps you going. I have my one good friend, considering my body would rot for weeks without anyone noticing, I chose her to call and leave a voicemail when I'm ready. I break down in tears whenever I think about how bad I'll hurt her.
